parts.html: Working with a professional interior designer can transform even the smallest bathroom. Here are some features and ideas that can be implemented:

items: Compact fixtures: Installing smaller sinks, toilets, and showers to make the most of the space.
Wall-hung elements: Wall-hung toilets and sinks create a sense of more space and make cleaning easier.
Even dark colors, such as graphite, can visually expand the space.
Good lighting: Recessed lights, a backlit mirror, LED strips under the cabinets or around the perimeter of the ceiling.
Large mirrors: Mirrors can significantly increase the sense of space. A full-wall mirror or large mirrored panels work especially well.
Built-in cabinets: Maximizing storage with built-in cabinets above the toilet.
We all know that glossy surfaces and finishes reflect light and make a room feel more spacious. But what if we want to minimize cleaning? That’s right — we choose the right matte texture.
Mosaic and tile: Using small mosaics or tiles to create interesting accents that draw attention away from the size of the room.
Minimalism: A minimal amount of decor to avoid clutter.

parts.html: An example of such a design might include a light color palette, a large mirrored wall, wall-hung fixtures, glossy tiles, and built-in cabinets, creating a sense of spaciousness and comfort even in the smallest bathroom.
